title: Provider dependence can increase as a system becomes specialised
text: Foss applies the make-or-buy question to AI itself: company-specific knowledge and integrations can create dependence on a provider even as technical access becomes easier. Procurement should examine adaptation, control and switching costs rather than compare the initial service fee alone.
qualification: Theoretical mechanism. It does not establish that internal development is inherently preferable.
